//: archive  a real picture from the period -- photograph, print, painting,
map. It is a RECORD. Carries artist, year, source.
made     generated or drawn. It is an ILLUSTRATION, and says so on screen.
Additionally requires method, claims and omits. check-data.py
fails a `made` entry missing any of them.
`claims` is one line saying what the picture asserts. `omits` is one line
saying what was deliberately kept OUT of frame because we do not know it.
The second field is the one that matters: the spike that produced this
taxonomy generated a grape bunch that is beautiful and is not Nebbiolo, and
a hillside with a steamboat on it in 1775. A picture may not be more
specific than the evidence, and `omits` is where that is written down.
